# AM7-R01 Synthetic Golden Replay v1

This fixture is deterministic, offline, and entirely synthetic. It was
created from the approved AM7-R01 synthetic text pool using the repository's
Store model, then loaded with the strict reader and replayed through R04,
R05, R06, and R07.

It contains no OCR capture, screenshot, résumé, candidate record, contact
detail, BOSS page body, keyword corpus, or log-derived text. All identifiers,
timestamps, coordinates, and hashes are deterministic synthetic fixture data.

## Coverage

- Initial screen and adjacent overlap (`screen-001`, `screen-002`)
- New content and protected short text (`screen-002`, `screen-003`)
- R05 document aggregation and R06 similarity/effective-new replay
- R07 two consecutive persisted no-new formal slots plus a deterministic
  position model (`synthetic-r07-candidate-001`)
- Strict reader, canonical digest, and expected-summary equivalence

`expected-summary.json` is a frozen, canonical replay projection. It is not
regenerated by tests: the test suite recomputes the same projections and
requires exact equality.
